title: Phase decision record
description: One decisions/<phase>.json. Written when a phase completes, so the reason a phase was considered done survives the conversation that produced it.

resource.description: The contract this phase was decided against. Recorded so a later reader can check the decision against the rule that applied at the time.

note.description: Why the phase is done. An empty note would make the record indistinguishable from a phase nobody thought about.
